name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_catalog
description: Discover the dynamic dashboard component catalog, binding syntax, custom component templates, and SuiteScript execution limits. Call before creating dashboards.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_list
description: List persistent dynamic dashboards. Search before creating duplicates.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_get
description: Read a dashboard's full layout, reusable components and actions code before editing.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_create
description: Create a persistent reactive SuiteScript dashboard, not a standalone MVC app. definition requires name,title,description,mode(client/server/hybrid),tags,initialState,layout,components,actions. Get catalog first. Nodes use {id,type,props,children,bind,actionId,input,visible}; values bind with {$bind:'state.field'} or {$bind:'results.actionId.result.field'}. Actions require {id,title,mode,risk,inputSchema,input,steps:[{id,domain,modules,code}]}. Modules are short names. Code reads input,previous,steps,context.modules and returns JSON; server is synchronous. Custom components use components.Name={description,template:[nodes]}, instantiated by custom:Name; props bindings use props.field. Creation never runs actions.

definition.description: Complete dashboard definition. Use catalog for supported components and execution contract.

verbose.description: Return full saved definition. Default false returns revision and changed ids only.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_update
description: Partially update a dashboard's metadata, layout, custom components or complete actions list. Omitted fields are preserved. Arrays are replaced. Requires current revision. Never runs code.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by get/create/update. Required to prevent stale edits or execution.

verbose.description: Return full saved definition. Default false returns revision and changed ids only.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_delete
description: Delete a persistent dashboard and its action definitions. Requires current revision.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by get/create/update. Required to prevent stale edits or execution.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_action
description: Create/update/delete one action and its SuiteScript code. upsert replaces the complete action with the same id. delete requires removing referencing buttons from layout/components first. Requires current revision.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by get/create/update. Required to prevent stale edits or execution.

verbose.description: Return full saved definition. Default false returns revision and changed ids only.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_run
description: Explicitly execute a reviewed saved dashboard action on the routed NetSuite account. Never call merely to create or preview a dashboard. Hybrid steps run sequentially, passing previous and steps results. Execution stops on errors; earlier writes are not rolled back. Requires current revision.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by get/create/update. Required to prevent stale edits or execution.

input.description: Concrete JSON input matching inputSchema; may be object, array, scalar or null.

verbose.description: Include intermediate step outputs. Default returns final result and setState only.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_node
description: Atomically upsert or remove nodes by id in layout, children or named slots. Existing upserts replace the node. New nodes append to parentId/slot or root. component targets a custom component template. Requires revision; validates before saving.

verbose.description: Return full saved definition. Default false returns revision and changed ids only.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_validate
description: Dry-run complete definition or stored dashboard plus patch. Returns valid, errors and warnings for schemas, bindings, missing actions, state fields, modules and duplicate ids. Never saves or runs code.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_render
description: Inspect actual Vue rendered text from the active dashboard, or an initial-state preview if no live view is open. Returns source, revision and text. Preview runs no actions or refresh; text can be truncated. No fabricated screenshot.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_code
description: Upsert/delete a stored source file referenced by step.codeFile or library.codeFile. source is literal code. Local MCP also accepts filePath to read UTF-8 without JSON escaping. Shared libraries return synchronous helper objects accessed as lib.Name.

verbose.description: Return full saved definition. Default false returns revision and changed ids only.

name.description: Portable relative source name, e.g. actions/reset.js.

filePath.description: Local UTF-8 code file path; only local MCP transports.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_export
description: Export portable dashboard JSON including sourceFiles. Local MCP directory optionally writes dashboard.json plus source files there without overwriting existing files unless overwrite:true.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_import
description: Import portable export as a new dashboard. Supply payload or local filePath to dashboard.json. Optional newName avoids conflicts. Validates without running code.

verbose.description: Return full saved definition. Default false returns revision and changed ids only.

name: magic_netsuite_dashboard_history
description: List retained versions (up to 20, bounded by storage), read revision definition, or restoreRevision as a new current revision. Restore requires expectedRevision. Never executes code.

verbose.description: Return full saved definition. Default false returns revision and changed ids only.
